token_holder.meaning: actual token holder, the from parameter whose balance is debited

caller_differs_from_holder.meaning: caller (msg.sender) differs from the actual token holder (from parameter) because transferFrom is used with an allowance

event_from_address.meaning: first argument (from) of the emitted ERC20 Transfer event

wallet_history_misleading.meaning: wallets and UIs displaying token history from events show misleading information about who sent tokens
wallet_history_misleading.checkpoint: after event consumption by off-chain consumers

assumptions: transferFrom is invoked with a valid allowance so the caller differs from the from parameter.
Off-chain wallets and UIs derive displayed token history from emitted Transfer events.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the caller is authorized; the caller is simply msg.sender using an allowance, so no authorization qualifier is encoded.

limitations: No concrete transaction, amounts, or observed event logs are supplied; the scenario is formalized generically.
The misleading-history impact is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric definition of misleading display.
